examples.en: A test strategy starts from risk, not from a coverage target.
examples.zh: 测试策略从风险出发，不是从覆盖率目标出发。

situation.en: My test strategy for the platform was risk-first: payments paths get everything, reports get smoke.
situation.zh: 面试官问你的测试实践，你回答：

entries.zh: 测试策略（整体怎么测的打法）

examples.en: Unit test coverage is a floor to notice, not a target to chase.
examples.zh: 单元测试覆盖率是用来留意的下限，不是用来追的目标。

situation.en: We track unit test coverage per module and review drops, not absolutes.
situation.zh: 你在质量评审会上这样说：

entries.zh: 单元测试覆盖率

examples.en: A contract test fails when a provider breaks a promise consumers rely on.
examples.zh: 当提供方打破消费者依赖的约定时，契约测试就会失败。

situation.en: Contract tests let the two teams deploy independently without a staging marriage.
situation.zh: 面试官问你的测试实践，你回答：

entries.zh: 契约测试（验证服务间接口约定）

examples.en: A consumer-driven contract records what each consumer actually needs.
examples.zh: 消费者驱动契约记录的是每个消费者真正需要的东西。

situation.en: We moved to consumer-driven contracts after one 'minor' field rename broke three apps.
situation.zh: 你在给团队定测试规范时这样讲：

entries.zh: 消费者驱动契约（由使用方定义接口期望）

examples.en: A mock object verifies the conversation, not just the answer.
examples.zh: 模拟对象验证的是对话过程，不只是答案。

situation.en: I reach for a mock object only at boundaries: payment gateways, email, clocks.
situation.zh: 面试官问你的测试实践，你回答：

entries.zh: 模拟对象（带期望校验的替身）

examples.en: A fake server answers real HTTP, so integration bugs surface early.
examples.zh: 假服务器能回应真实 HTTP，集成问题能早点暴露。

situation.en: Our fake server replays recorded bank responses, including the weird ones.
situation.zh: 你在给团队定测试规范时这样讲：

entries.zh: 假服务器（能跑真实协议的轻量替身）

examples.en: A test fixture builds the same tiny world for every test.
examples.zh: 测试夹具为每个测试搭建同一个小世界。

situation.en: Shared fixtures were our biggest source of order-dependent tests; now each test builds its own.
situation.zh: 面试官问你的测试实践，你回答：

entries.zh: 测试夹具（为测试准备的固定环境/数据）

examples.en: Test data management decides how realistic data reaches test environments safely.
examples.zh: 测试数据管理决定真实感的数据如何安全地进入测试环境。

situation.en: Our test data management masks production snapshots before anyone can use them.
situation.zh: 你在质量评审会上这样说：

entries.zh: 测试数据管理

examples.en: Seed data should tell a story: a user, an order, a refund.
examples.zh: 种子数据应该讲一个故事：一个用户、一笔订单、一次退款。

situation.en: When seed data rots, every new hire's first week gets slower.
situation.zh: 你在给团队定测试规范时这样讲：

entries.zh: 种子数据（预置的基础数据）

examples.en: Test flakiness is a tax every engineer pays daily until someone owns it.
examples.zh: 测试不稳定性是每个工程师每天都在交的税，直到有人出来治理它。

situation.en: We cut test flakiness by fixing clocks and network in tests, not by retrying harder.
situation.zh: 面试官问你的测试实践，你回答：

entries.zh: 测试不稳定性（flaky 的程度与治理）

examples.en: When you quarantine a test, file the ticket in the same commit.
examples.zh: 隔离一个测试时，在同一个提交里把工单建好。

situation.en: We quarantine a test for at most two weeks; after that it is fixed or deleted.
situation.zh: 你在质量评审会上这样说：

entries.zh: 隔离一个测试（把不稳定的先摘出去）

examples.en: Mutation testing asks whether your tests would notice a real bug.
examples.zh: 变异测试问的是：你的测试到底能不能发现真正的 bug。

situation.en: Mutation testing humbled our ninety-percent coverage in one afternoon.
situation.zh: 面试官问你的测试实践，你回答：

entries.zh: 变异测试（故意改坏代码看测试抓不抓得到）

examples.en: Property-based testing found the rounding case our examples never imagined.
examples.zh: 基于属性的测试找到了我们例子里从没想到的舍入情况。

situation.en: For parsers and pricing, property-based testing beats a hundred hand-written cases.
situation.zh: 你在给团队定测试规范时这样讲：

entries.zh: 基于属性的测试（用生成数据验证不变量）

examples.en: Fuzz testing feeds the parser garbage until it confesses.
examples.zh: 模糊测试给解析器喂垃圾，直到它招供为止。

situation.en: One night of fuzz testing found more crashes than a year of code review.
situation.zh: 面试官问你的测试实践，你回答：

entries.zh: 模糊测试（喂随机畸形输入找崩溃）

examples.en: A visual regression test notices the button moved three pixels left.
examples.zh: 视觉回归测试能发现按钮向左挪了三个像素。

situation.en: Visual regression tests guard the design system, not every marketing page.
situation.zh: 你在质量评审会上这样说：

entries.zh: 视觉回归测试（比对页面截图变化）

examples.en: Accessibility testing catches what sighted developers never see.
examples.zh: 无障碍测试能抓住有视力的开发者永远看不到的问题。

situation.en: We run accessibility testing in CI; the failures are mostly labels and contrast.
situation.zh: 面试官问你的测试实践，你回答：

entries.zh: 无障碍测试

examples.en: The golden file is the approved output; any diff needs a human yes.
examples.zh: 黄金文件是被批准过的输出；任何差异都需要人点头。

situation.en: Reports render against a golden file so format changes are always deliberate.
situation.zh: 你在给团队定测试规范时这样讲：

entries.zh: 黄金文件（人工确认过的标准输出）

examples.en: Test environment parity is why staging bugs predict production bugs.
examples.zh: 测试环境一致性决定了预发的 bug 能不能预言生产的 bug。

situation.en: We invest in test environment parity for data shape, not for hardware size.
situation.zh: 你在质量评审会上这样说：

entries.zh: 测试环境一致性（和生产有多像）

examples.en: The regression suite runs nightly; the smoke subset gates every merge.
examples.zh: 回归测试套件每晚跑；冒烟子集卡住每次合并。

situation.en: A regression suite that nobody trusts gets muted, so we keep it under twenty minutes.
situation.zh: 面试官问你的测试实践，你回答：

entries.zh: 回归测试套件

examples.en: A test report should lead with risk: what is untested and why.
examples.zh: 测试报告应该先讲风险：什么没测、为什么。

situation.en: Our test report names the three riskiest untested paths explicitly.
situation.zh: 你在质量评审会上这样说：

entries.zh: 测试报告

examples.en: Defect leakage measures the bugs your process was supposed to catch.
examples.zh: 缺陷泄漏度量的是你的流程本应抓住却漏掉的 bug。

situation.en: Defect leakage, not bug count, is the metric I report upward.
situation.zh: 面试官问你的测试实践，你回答：

entries.zh: 缺陷泄漏（漏到生产才发现的 bug 比例）

examples.en: Bug triage is thirty minutes of deciding what not to fix.
examples.zh: 缺陷分诊就是用三十分钟决定哪些不修。

situation.en: In bug triage we rank by user impact, then by age.
situation.zh: 你在质量评审会上这样说：

entries.zh: 缺陷分诊（给 bug 定级排序的会）

examples.en: Severity vs priority: a typo on the payment page is low severity, top priority.
examples.zh: 严重程度与优先级的区别：支付页上的错别字严重程度低，优先级最高。

situation.en: Teaching severity vs priority ended most arguments in triage.
situation.zh: 你在给团队定测试规范时这样讲：

entries.zh: 严重程度与优先级的区别

examples.en: Reproducible steps turn an angry report into a fixable bug.
examples.zh: 复现步骤能把一份愤怒的反馈变成一个可修的 bug。

situation.en: No reproducible steps, no ticket: that rule protects everyone's time.
situation.zh: 面试官问你的测试实践，你回答：

entries.zh: 复现步骤

examples.en: A minimal reproduction is a gift to whoever fixes the bug.
examples.zh: 最小复现是送给修 bug 的人的礼物。

situation.en: I ask reporters for a minimal reproduction before I open the debugger.
situation.zh: 你在给团队定测试规范时这样讲：

entries.zh: 最小复现（剥到最简的出问题例子）

examples.en: Exploratory testing finds the bugs the scripts were never told about.
examples.zh: 探索性测试能找到脚本从来没被告知过的 bug。

situation.en: We charter exploratory testing sessions before every major release.
situation.zh: 你在质量评审会上这样说：

entries.zh: 探索性测试（边想边测的人工测试）

examples.en: Session-based testing gives exploration a charter and a clock.
examples.zh: 基于会话的测试给探索定了章程和时钟。

situation.en: In session-based testing, a tester explores one risk area for ninety minutes and reports back.
situation.zh: 你向新同事解释你们的测试方式，这样说：

entries.zh: 基于会话的测试（限时、有章程的探索测试）

examples.en: Risk-based testing spends the budget where failure hurts most.
examples.zh: 基于风险的测试把预算花在失败最痛的地方。

situation.en: Risk-based testing is how a small team covers a big surface honestly.
situation.zh: 面试官问你的测试实践，你回答：

entries.zh: 基于风险的测试（先测最怕出事的地方）

examples.en: Shift-left testing means reviewing testability during design, not after code.
examples.zh: 测试左移意味着在设计阶段就评审可测性，而不是代码写完之后。

situation.en: Shift-left testing cut our late-stage surprises more than any tool purchase.
situation.zh: 你在质量评审会上这样说：

entries.zh: 测试左移（把质量活动提前到开发早期）

examples.en: A quality gate that people route around is decoration, not a gate.
examples.zh: 一道被人绕着走的质量门禁只是装饰，不是门禁。

situation.en: Our quality gate checks coverage on changed code only; legacy debt has its own plan.
situation.zh: 你在给团队定测试规范时这样讲：

entries.zh: 质量门禁（不达标就不许过）

examples.en: Set the coverage threshold on new code, or the number becomes theater.
examples.zh: 覆盖率阈值要定在新代码上，不然这个数字就是演戏。

situation.en: The coverage threshold is eighty on diffs; the repo average climbs behind it.
situation.zh: 面试官问你的测试实践，你回答：

entries.zh: 覆盖率阈值（门禁的数字线）

examples.en: Branch coverage exposes the else your line coverage never visited.
examples.zh: 分支覆盖率能暴露出行覆盖率从没去过的那个 else。

situation.en: For pricing logic I read branch coverage, not line coverage.
situation.zh: 你在给团队定测试规范时这样讲：

entries.zh: 分支覆盖率

examples.en: Every boundary value deserves a test: zero, one, max, max plus one.
examples.zh: 每个边界值都值得一个用例：零、一、最大值、最大值加一。

situation.en: Check the boundary value on the discount threshold; that's where the last bug lived.
situation.zh: 你评审测试用例时这样提醒同事：

entries.zh: 边界值（测试用例设计法）

examples.en: Equivalence partitioning turns infinite inputs into a handful of classes.
examples.zh: 等价类划分把无穷的输入变成几个类别。

situation.en: With equivalence partitioning, one case per class is enough until a class misbehaves.
situation.zh: 你给实习生讲测试设计，这样说：

entries.zh: 等价类划分（测试用例设计法）
